Scenario Description: Successful login lands the doctor on Care View
Open Dashboard from the header logo
Expected Result: URL path is /admin; module tiles render.

Scenario Description: Direct URL navigation to /admin preserves session
Expected Result: Dashboard renders without redirecting to login.

Scenario Description: Dashboard lists all eight module tiles in order
Expected Result: Headings in order: Care View, Patients, Drug Cabinet, Diagnosis, Investigations, Report Templates, Documents, Queue View.

Scenario Description: Each tile links to the correct module route
Expected Result: Every tile href matches its module route.

Scenario Description: Clicking each clinical tile opens that module
Test Steps: 1. For each of the 7 clinical tiles: open Dashboard, click tile, verify route
Expected Result: Each click navigates to the matching module route.

Scenario Description: Header exposes links to every clinical module
Expected Result: All seven module links and the logo link are visible.

Scenario Description: Header navigation works from a non-dashboard module
Test Steps: 1. Open Patients from header; 2. Open Documents from header; 3. Click logo
Expected Result: Each transition succeeds; Dashboard shows all 8 tiles.

Scenario Description: Switcher shows active practice and lists it
Test Steps: 1. Read practice name in header; 2. Open switcher
Expected Result: Practice name is shown; the same practice appears as an option.

Scenario Description: No-match practice search shows empty state
Expected Result: "No hospitals available!" shown with zero options; Escape closes popover.

Scenario Description: Avatar menu shows doctor identity and actions
Expected Result: Menu shows doctor name ("Dr. …"), email, Account Management, Log out; Escape closes it.

Scenario Description: Log out ends the session and protects admin routes
Expected Result: Redirect to /login on logout; revisiting an admin route redirects to /login again.

Scenario Description: Queue View renders waiting-room idle state
Expected Result: URL /admin/queue-view; today's long-form date, "Waiting for Next Patient" and token instructions are visible.

Scenario Description: Close control returns to the Dashboard
Expected Result: Navigates back to /admin; Dashboard tiles render.
